name: Poly Plastic Masterbatch (SuZhou) Co.,Ltd
summary: Poly Plastic Masterbatch (SuZhou) Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of solution-dyed chemical fibers and advanced functional modified materials in China and internationally. The company offers chemical fibers, plastic, and film masterbatches, as well as inks and color pastes for chemical fiber, automotive, electronic and electrical, optical material, and other materials. It provides technical support for product applications. Poly Plastic Masterbatch (SuZhou) Co.,Ltd was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
